keywords_en: criminal; false accusation; second instance; High People's Court; Sichuan Province; natural person; Criminal Law; whether constitutes the crime of false accusation; whether it is a mistaken accusation or inaccurate report; uphold the original judgment; fabricate facts; falsely accuse others; embezzlement; theft; bribery
full_text_en:
He Dexu — false accusation case

Defendant: He Dexu, male, 48 years old, formerly a worker at Chongqing Furniture Factory No. 1 in Sichuan Province. Arrested on July 9, 1986.

In 1982, while engaged in marketing theater seats for Chongqing Furniture Factory No. 1, the defendant He Dexu was disciplined with a major demerit, forfeiture of bonuses, and restitution of illicit gains for soliciting bribes and embezzling RMB 647. He Dexu was extremely dissatisfied with this and believed that Ye Zubi, the Party branch secretary of the factory, had targeted him, thereby harboring vengeful intentions. From January 1983 to March 1984, He Dexu successively wrote 22 letters to leading organs and political-legal departments of Sichuan Province and Chongqing Municipality, fabricating facts that Ye Zubi, alone or in collusion with others, had embezzled state and collective property and accepted bribes totaling over RMB 10,000, and requested that criminal liability be pursued in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law.

The defendant He Dexu was prosecuted for false accusation by the Chongqing Municipal People's Procuratorate of Sichuan Province before the Chongqing Intermediate People's Court. After accepting the case, the Chongqing Intermediate People's Court formed a collegial panel according to law and, following a public trial, found the following:

From September 1979 to early 1982, when Chongqing Furniture Factory No. 1 was constructing its plant, He Dexu was a member of the capital construction office. He clearly knew that the construction project was under the charge of Factory Manager Fu XX, and that Ye Zubi was not in charge of capital construction. He also knew that the construction unit's withdrawal of part of the construction fees was used for on-site entertainment expenses, yet he fabricated that Ye Zubi had received a kickback bribe of RMB 7,700 from the construction team.

In the construction of the plant, the contract signed between Chongqing Furniture Factory No. 1 and the construction unit stipulated: "Where piecework wages cannot be used for settlement in the project, an agreement may be reached to pay wages in the form of time rates or other methods." He Dexu was not only aware of this provision but also signed for reimbursement five times on time-work sheets as a price estimator or recorder. He knew that Ye Zubi had nothing to do with this matter, yet he deliberately fabricated that Ye Zubi had forged a large number of time-work records and embezzled RMB 1,000.

In early 1980, during the capital construction of Chongqing Furniture Factory No. 1, there was a shortage of cement. He Dexu, through Qian XX, contacted a military unit and obtained 5 tons of cement. The unit required cash, but the furniture factory could not pay, so it did not take the cement. Later, through He Dexu's contact, the unit sold the cement to a food processing factory, and Qian XX collected the cash. He Dexu knew that this matter had nothing to do with Ye Zubi, yet he fabricated that Ye Zubi had colluded with others to steal 5 tons of cement from the military unit and had shared RMB 420 from the cement proceeds.

From November 1979 to February 1980, military officers Wei XX and Xu XX bought some used cement formwork panels and used construction shed materials from a construction unit and entrusted Qian XX to find someone to make furniture. Qian XX found Factory Manager Fu XX of Chongqing Furniture Factory No. 1 and requested assistance. With Fu XX's consent, the processing was undertaken by the factory and Baishiyi Iron Factory respectively, and Wei XX and Xu XX paid the processing fees. Qian XX and Wei XX had informed He Dexu of this matter, and the furniture made at the iron factory was even delivered by He Dexu to the furniture factory for painting. Nevertheless, He Dexu accused Ye Zubi of colluding with others to steal a truckload of materials and 1.6 cubic meters of timber from the military unit.

The above criminal facts are confirmed by witness testimony, victim statements, the defendant's false accusation letters, audit materials, contract documents, and other evidence. The evidence is reliable and sufficient, and the defendant He Dexu also confessed.

The Chongqing Intermediate People's Court held that the defendant He Dexu, dissatisfied with being disciplined, fabricated facts and falsely accused others, thereby infringing upon the personal rights and physical and mental health of the victim and seriously disrupting the normal activities of Party and government organs and judicial organs. The circumstances were flagrant, and his conduct constituted the crime of false accusation as stipulated in Article 138, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China. Accordingly, on March 20, 1987, the court sentenced the defendant He Dexu to three years' imprisonment for the crime of false accusation.

The defendant He Dexu, dissatisfied with the judgment at first instance, appealed to the Sichuan High People's Court on the grounds that the issues he had raised were not fabricated but had a factual basis, and that the sentence was too severe.

The Sichuan High People's Court, after trial, held that the appellant He Dexu, dissatisfied with being disciplined for corruption and bribery, harbored vengeful intentions, fabricated facts to falsely accuse others of crimes of corruption, bribery, and theft, and sought to pursue their criminal liability. The conduct of the appellant He Dexu did not constitute a mistaken accusation or an unsubstantiated report; it indeed constituted the crime of false accusation. The appellant He Dexu's grounds of appeal were untenable. The facts found in the original judgment were clear, the conviction was accurate, the sentence was appropriate, and the trial procedure was lawful. In accordance with Article 136, Item (1) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, on April 26, 1987, the court ruled to dismiss the appeal and affirm the original judgment.
